summary: Planned 1922 steel lookout on Pilot Mountain near Brevard; the county library and a summit guide both say the tower is removed; the summit is a hiking spot.

facts.status_note: The Transylvania County library says the tower on Pilot Mountain has been removed. A user-written summit guide (Summit Post) says the same.

access.note: On Pisgah National Forest land, reached on foot by the Art Loeb Trail.

visit.trail_note: About two miles one way from Gloucester Gap along the Art Loeb Trail, per a user-written summit guide.

events.note: Steel tower judged necessary and a cabin planned, per a November 1922 newspaper item that calls the peak Pilot Knob; completion is not confirmed in these sources

evidence.supports: 1922: a steel tower is made necessary for lookout use on the peak
evidence.quote: Owing to the peak-like contour of Pilot Knob in Transylvania County, this point for lookout purposes is regarded as ideal, and in fact makes necessary the construction of a steel tower.

evidence.supports: The 1922 cabin is described as planned, not built
evidence.quote: A cabin, in which the windows entirely surround the structure, is planned here

evidence.supports: Transylvania County once had five lookouts, including one on Pilot Mountain
evidence.quote: Transylvania County once had five fire lookout towers, located at Fryingpan Mountain, Pilot Mountain, Rich Mountain, Sassafras Mountain, and Toxaway Mountain.

evidence.supports: The tower on Pilot Mountain has been removed
evidence.quote: The towers at Pilot and Sassafras mountains have been removed.

evidence.supports: Location: near Brevard, within Pisgah National Forest (agency)
evidence.quote: The mountain is located near Brevard, NC within the Pisgah Ranger District of Pisgah National Forest.

evidence.supports: The Art Loeb Trail crosses the mountain (public trail access)
evidence.quote: The mountain is crossed by the Art Loeb Trail.

evidence.supports: Shortest approach about 2 miles one way from Gloucester Gap
evidence.quote: Gloucester Gap provides the shortest option, approximately 2 miles of hiking one direction

evidence.supports: The top is a small clearing with views, including of Looking Glass
evidence.quote: Here, at the top, is a small clearing that allows some nice views including good views of Looking Glass

evidence.supports: Summit guide: the tower has been removed (the guide does not describe any remains)
evidence.quote: Previously Pilot Mountain held a lookout tower. It has since been removed.

evidence.supports: Summit guide: maps still label the tower, though it is no longer present
evidence.quote: The lookout tower is still labeled on many maps, though it is no longer present.

sources.title: Lookout Towers Played role in Preserving Forests

notes_for_editor: Record status was unknown; the library says the tower is removed, and the summit guide agrees (facts.status). No removal date and no build date were found: the 1922 item says planned only. The record has no height. The 1922 item says Pilot Knob. Do not confuse this peak with the Pilot Mountain in Surry County, which the summit guide warns about. The summit guide is user-written. It does say the tower has been removed and is still labeled on many maps; it does not describe any remains, so the story says that and nothing more. One WebSearch used for this tower.
